data: Massive SPY one-minute split-adjusted trade aggregates, 2015-01-01 through 2026-10-02; daily bars and historical cash dividends for prior-close signal

hypotheses.momentum: Sign of (09:59 minute close + ex-date cash dividend)/previous official daily close - 1 predicts late-session return. This is a shortened, delayed-execution adaptation of Gao et al. (2018), not an exact replication.
hypotheses.extreme_reversal: At 15:30, if absolute(open-to-15:29 minute close return) exceeds 2 times the standard deviation of the same return over the previous 60 full sessions (60 required), trade opposite its sign; otherwise flat. No threshold/window sweep.

execution: One dollar of SPY notional per dollar of capital; +/-1 or flat; entry at 15:31 minute open, exit at 15:59 minute open. Prices are trade-print proxies, not executable quotes. Fixed costs account for estimated spread/fees/slippage. Entry delayed to 15:32 as mandatory sensitivity, exit unchanged.
cash_convention: Cash yield set to zero, fully collateralized notional, no leverage. Performance is incremental trading P&L per full account equity. No interest on short proceeds; one calendar day of 1% annualized borrow charged per short trade. Do not add a risk-free rate to gross Sharpe.
calendar: Retain every observed SPY daily session, including flat and excluded days. Exclude all July 2/3, December 24, Friday after fourth November Thursday to conservatively avoid early closes, even when some of those dates were full sessions. Require all signal/entry/exit minute bars and positive prices. Missing observations are flat and separately reported.
splits_dividends: Massive bars split-adjusted but not dividend-adjusted. Add ex-date cash dividend to current 09:59 price when computing previous-close momentum signal. All actual holdings intraday so no dividend cashflow earned or paid. Verify SPY split history.
benchmarks: Always long identical 15:31–15:59 window with identical costs
Daily SPY close-to-close for beta diagnostic only
statistics: 252-day annualized Sharpe calculated on every session including flat days; arithmetic mean annualized, compound CAGR, max drawdown; Newey-West HAC lag 5 mean t-stat, stationary 10-session-block bootstrap Sharpe CI using seed 731 and 2000 replicates; daily market beta and alpha HAC; yearly table; two-sided p-values Holm-adjusted over the two hypotheses. No selecting configurations from holdout.
gate: Candidate requires positive validation and holdout base-cost mean, holdout Sharpe >=0.75, positive stress-cost holdout mean, positive delayed-entry holdout mean, and holdout two-sided mean p<0.05 after Holm adjustment. This is a research screen, not a claim of executable fills, institutional capacity, or future profitability.
